inv.desc_es:
Traspaso: 380.000. -€
Bar restaurante C3 con una fachada acristalada de 7m², situado en el Gótico, a pocos metros de Jaume I, zona de muchísimo paso. El local tiene 240m² repartidos en 2 plantas. Consta de comedor para 39 comensales, 2 barras de 4 metros y 8 taburetes, con cafetera, 2 tiradores de cerveza, botelleria y lavavasos. Cuenta con cocina de 18m² acondicionada con salida de humos, 7 neveras, 4 congeladores, lavavajillas, horno, cocina de butano de 4 fuegos, y plancha. Se encuentra insonorizado, ignifugado, aire acondicionado, almacén y 3 aseos a cuál uno es para el personal. 

Contrato: 15 años
Fianza Incasol: 2 meses 
Garantía adicional: a valorar.
inv.desc_en:
Transfer fee: €380,000
C3 bar-restaurant with a 7m² glass facade, located in the Gothic Quarter, a few meters from Jaume I, in a very high-foot-traffic area. The premises have 240m² spread over 2 floors. It consists of a dining room for 39 guests, two 4-meter bars with 8 stools, a coffee machine, 2 beer taps, bottle racks, and a glass washer. It features an 18m² kitchen equipped with a smoke vent, 7 refrigerators, 4 freezers, a dishwasher, an oven, a 4-burner butane stove, and a griddle. It is soundproofed, fireproofed, and includes air conditioning, a storage room, and 3 restrooms, one of which is for staff.

Contract: 15 years
Incasol deposit: 2 months
Additional guarantee: to be assessed.
